title: list_snapshot.v1
description: The sidecar of one saved list page (`crawl-lists --snapshot`), at DATA/raw/lists/<site>/<crawl_id>/<page>.json next to <page>.html.gz. It is written BEFORE any parse or stop decision, so it records what the HTML alone cannot prove: the status and the final URL (ADR-0017 A.1).

final_url.description: Where the GET ended, after any redirect.

status.description: The HTTP status of the final response.

reason.description: challenge.detect's reason code for the page (null: a normal list page).

outcome.description: listed: handed to the list parser, rows kept; past_end: answered 404/410, saved and recorded, not a challenge; redirected: final_url differs from requested_url, saved, its cards counted but not kept; stopped: a challenge stop (exit 5), as without snapshots.

parsed.description: Cards the list parser returned (null: not parsed, e.g. a challenge, or the parser raised).

skipped.description: Cards the parser skipped, when the source reports it (ListPage.skipped).

body.description: The gzip body's raw_ref (sha256 and bytes of the UNCOMPRESSED HTML). null for a page with a challenge sign: its body stays in STATE (stops/, never synced), named by the challenge event.
